title: IndexError while importing a CSV file (excel.read)
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.1.7; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region ap-south-1.

STEPS:

Steps to reproduce:
* With the log window open, start importing a CSV file.
* Make sure the input ends without a trailing blank line.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

EXPECTED:

Expected importing a CSV file to finish without errors.

ACTUAL:

Every row works except the last row, which raises. Adding a line moves the failure to the new last row.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:88 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:55 in run_import
lattice/io/excel.py:98 in read
IndexError: list index out of range
